messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Hi, I'm an AI interview assistant. This call is being transcribed for the hiring team, and a person, not the AI, makes the final decision. I'll ask you a few questions about the projects on your resume.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: How did you design the REST APIs for the NABHA Telemedicine Platform to handle growing user loads efficiently?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: We build APIs so they could scale as more users came in.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said "scale as more users". What exactly did you do there, step by step?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: I built the clinic lookup for the emergency SOS feature. Which finds nearby clinics from the user's location. It covered fifty plus clinics and was tested with over hundred users.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thank you. Moving on. How did you ensure high reliability and stability for the CivicFix platform in production?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: Could you please repeat the question?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: How did you ensure high reliability and stability for the CivicFix platform in production?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: Could you please repeat the question?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: No problem, let's move on. For your Formula One Race Strategy Optimizer, how did you collaborate with product teams to define the Streamlit app's features?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said "I". What exactly did you do there, step by step?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: I built the issue analyzer seven day duplicate detections so repeat reports of the same problem get caught. We were a team of four, and it's run with over hundred registered users and more than fifty ish... Fifty issues logged.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thank you. Moving on. For the NABHA Telemedicine Platform, what Python tools did you use to build the backend?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thanks, that's all my questions. The transcript of this call now goes to the hiring team, and a person there will review it and decide the next step.
